description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Moves a signed version. action stable {serial, expect}: makes it the version players get; expect is the serial you saw as stable (0 when there is none yet), so two moves at once can't cross. action tier {serial, tier}: who gets it, 1 only you, 2 your friends, 3 everyone in casual (needs two-factor on your account and the uploader's, the uploader in good standing and the pack's own checks; no match record). Ranked is YouGame's approval of one exact version, never set here.
